extDescription.message: Translate YouTube subtitles into your language with a local AI model (Ollama). Nothing leaves your computer.

cmdToggle.message: Toggle subtitle translation on the current video

toastNoCaptions.message: $P1$ ⚠ This video has no subtitles to translate

errReloaded.message: The extension was reloaded – refresh this page.

errModelMissing.message: Model “$P1$” is not downloaded – click the extension icon → “Setup” to get it (or run: ollama pull $P1$)

err403.message: Ollama refused the connection (403). Set the environment variable OLLAMA_ORIGINS=chrome-extension://* and restart Ollama.

errTimeout.message: Ollama did not respond in time (is the model too large or too slow for this computer?)

errNoConnection.message: Cannot connect to Ollama at $P1$. Is it running? Click the extension icon → “Setup”.

popupToggleTitle.message: Turn the whole extension on or off

lblShowOriginal.message: Also show the original line below

lblHideSoundTags.message: Hide sound descriptions such as [Music] or [Applause]

lblAutoTranslate.message: Translate every video automatically (no button click)

msgNoPermission.message: Without access to $P1$ the extension cannot connect to that address.

msgTesting.message: Translating (the first run loads the model – this can take a while)…

stOpenVideo.message: Open a specific video on YouTube.

stOffForVideo.message: Off for this video – click “$P1$” in the player (or Alt+Shift+P).

setupSub.message: This wizard prepares a local translator. Everything runs on your computer – subtitles are never sent to the internet.

s1Checking.message: Checking whether Ollama is already installed…

s1NotInstalledDl.message: Ollama is not installed yet. Click the button and the wizard will download the installer$P1$.

afterWin.message: Windows may ask for permission – confirm it. Installation takes about a minute, then Ollama starts by itself (icon next to the clock).

afterMac.message: A window will open – drag the Ollama icon into Applications, then start Ollama from Applications.

runFallback.message: Can't open the file directly – the downloads folder is open, double-click $P1$.

linuxText.message: On Linux the browser cannot run the installer. Paste this one line into a terminal:

waitingOllama.message: Waiting for Ollama to start… the wizard will continue by itself.

m4Desc.message: – about 3.3 GB. Fast, runs on most computers.

m12Desc.message: – about 8 GB. Better translations, needs a graphics card with ~12 GB of memory.

pullError.message: Download error: $P1$. Click again – the download will resume.

pullKeepOpen.message: Don't close this tab while downloading. An interrupted download resumes where it stopped.

s3Warming.message: Warming up the model with a test translation…

s3Info.message: Open a video on YouTube and click the language button (e.g. EN) in the player bar – subtitles will be translated automatically. Change the target language with the extension icon. Alt+Shift+P works like clicking the button.
